primitives.verbatim_quote: # unibet.com Category: **sportsbook** URLs discovered: **3** Sitemaps walked: 15 ## Sitemaps | Sitemap | Status
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'G': 'graph of sitemap URLs', 'V': 'vertices (URLs)', 'E': 'edges (crawl links)', 'n_s': 'number of sitemaps walked'}
primitives.assumptions: All sitemaps are accessible via HTTP GET; graph is directed and acyclic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When n_s → ∞, convergence to full URL coverage occurs.

layer2.mapping: Each sitemap entry maps to a node in GSI's Bayesian belief network; GSE uses this for path planning.

primitives.name: URL Taxonomy Classifier
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T': 'taxonomy vector space', 't_i': 'URL segment type', 'c_i': 'count of URLs in t_i'}
primitives.assumptions: URL segments form orthogonal categories; each URL belongs to one category.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When c_i = 0, t_i is inactive or deprecated.

layer2.mapping: Classifies URLs into functional types for GSI's path-space model; GSE uses this for navigation logic.
layer2.telemetry: Segment type and URL count per taxonomy.

primitives.name: HTTP Status Validator
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'status code set', 's_i': 'individual HTTP status code', 'p(s_i)': 'probability of s_i occurring'}
primitives.assumptions: Status codes follow a known distribution over time; 2xx implies valid resource.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When p(s_i) < threshold, sitemap is considered stale or misconfigured.

layer2.mapping: Maps HTTP responses to GSI's confidence-weighted path validity; GSE uses this for routing decisions.
layer2.telemetry: Observed HTTP status codes and response counts.

The URL taxonomy classifier partitions this graph into orthogonal functional segments, enabling probabilistic classification of URL utility. Failure modes include 404s indicating dead links, 204s suggesting empty resources, and missing sitemaps implying incomplete indexing. These failures propagate through the system as reduced confidence in path coverage and degraded state estimation.
